title: Form 27B/6: Declaration of Declarations
body:
It has come to the attention of the Ministry that this facility has declared things without first declaring that it intended to declare them.

Form 27B/6 must be completed, countersigned and retroactively pre-approved.

choices.label: APPROVE
choices.outcome: The form was approved, stamped and filed under 'Approved'. Nobody will read it again.

choices.label: DENY
choices.outcome: The form was denied. The Ministry notes your confidence.

choices.label: FILE IN TRIPLICATE
choices.outcome: Three copies were filed. Two were lost; the third was lost more carefully.

title: Notice of Scheduled Surprise Audit
body: The Bureau of Verification will arrive unannounced at a time it has already announced. Please ensure the facility looks as though it has always been ready.

choices.label: COOPERATE
choices.outcome: Auditors found nothing, then billed you for the finding.

choices.label: STALL
choices.outcome: The audit was rescheduled to a date that does not exist. Goodwill was not.

choices.label: FILE IN TRIPLICATE
choices.hint: -$60k now · standing +1 · rack failure rate x0.9 for 2d
choices.outcome: A provisional compliance certificate was issued, valid for the period it is displayed.

title: Department of Misplaced Compute: Claim 4471
body:
The Department of Misplaced Compute asserts that four spare components in your depot were inventoried to the wrong department in 1987.

The Department requests their return, or a letter explaining why not.

choices.label: RETURN THE PARTS
choices.outcome: The parts were returned. A receipt was issued for a different set of parts.

choices.label: DENY
choices.outcome: The claim was denied. A counter-claim has been prepared, in advance, against you.

choices.label: FILE IN TRIPLICATE
choices.outcome: A letter was written. It was long. The Department stopped reading at the second page.

title: Subsidy for Domestic Computational Enthusiasm
body:
A subsidy is available to facilities that demonstrably enthuse. Enthusiasm will be measured by the Department of Enthusiasm Measurement.

Conditions apply. The conditions are the subsidy.

choices.label: APPLY
choices.outcome: Funds arrived. So did the reporting requirements.

choices.label: DECLINE
choices.outcome: You declined a subsidy. The Ministry has never seen this before and is concerned.

choices.label: FILE IN TRIPLICATE
choices.hint: +$90k now · new contract payouts x0.9 for 1d
choices.outcome: A reduced grant was awarded, with a reduced obligation to be pleased about it.

title: Fire Safety Inspection (Annual, Biannual)
body:
An inspector will verify that the facility is fire-safe. In doing so, the inspector will bring a lighter, as is customary.

Placards are required on every wall that has a wall.

choices.label: PAY THE FEES
choices.outcome: Fees paid. The facility is now certified safe, by decree.

choices.label: CONTEST
choices.outcome: The inspector filed a formal disagreement with the existence of your argument.

choices.label: INSTALL PLACARDS
choices.outcome: Four hundred placards were installed. The walls feel crowded.

title: Memo: The Ministry Has Been Renamed
body:
Effective yesterday, the Ministry is now the Ministry of Compute and Adjacent Matters. All stationery, signage and letterheads must reflect this, retroactively.

The old name is to be forgotten collectively.

choices.label: REPRINT STATIONERY
choices.outcome: Stationery reprinted. The new letterhead is indistinguishable from the old.

choices.label: IGNORE
choices.outcome: You continue to use the old name. The Ministry has noted that it continues to exist.

choices.label: REBRAND THE ENTIRE FACILITY
choices.outcome: Every sign was replaced. Two were replaced twice.

title: National Census of Compute (Optional, Mandatory)
body:
All facilities must report their exact number of computers. Facilities reporting inaccurate figures will be corrected by the Ministry.

The Ministry's figure is final, and will be provided after yours.

choices.label: REPORT HONESTLY
choices.outcome: Your figure was accepted and entered into a ledger that has since been mislaid.

choices.label: UNDERREPORT
choices.outcome: A smaller figure was filed. The Ministry was moved by your modesty and your taxes.

choices.label: FILE IN TRIPLICATE
choices.outcome: Three different figures were filed. The Ministry averaged them.

title: Notice: Official Stamp Shortage
body:
The Ministry has run out of the stamp that confirms receipt of stamp requests. Requests for stamps will be stamped once stamps resume.

In the meantime, please surrender any spare parts that resemble stamps.

choices.label: APPROVE REQUISITION
choices.outcome: Parts were requisitioned as stamps. They are now stamps.

choices.label: DENY
choices.outcome: You retained your parts. The shortage was reclassified as a surplus of absences.

choices.label: PURCHASE PRIVATE STAMPS
choices.outcome: Private stamps were bought at a ministerial markup.

title: Special Levy on Electricity Consumed While Consuming
body:
A one-time levy has been introduced to recover the cost of introducing it. Facilities may pay immediately, or later, with more.

The levy will be refunded as soon as it is understood.

choices.label: PAY IN FULL
choices.outcome: Paid. The Ministry issued you a receipt for the receipt.

choices.label: DISPUTE
choices.outcome: The dispute was filed. Energy prices were adjusted while it is pending.

choices.label: FILE IN TRIPLICATE
choices.hint: -$40k now · energy price x1.1 for 2d · standing +1
choices.outcome: A payment plan was agreed. It has no end and no beginning.

title: Visiting Delegation from the Ministry of Visits
body:
A delegation will inspect your facility, your hospitality, and the relationship between them.

Please prepare refreshments that are neither lavish nor insufficient, as defined in an appendix not yet written.

choices.label: HOST A BANQUET
choices.outcome: The delegation ate. Standing rose. Several guests remain in the building.

choices.label: TOUR ONLY
choices.outcome: A brisk tour was conducted. The delegation noted the briskness.

choices.label: DECLINE POLITELY
choices.outcome: The delegation was disappointed to be declined in a way they could not appeal.

title: Regulation 14(c): Cooling Must Be Seen to Be Done
body:
All facilities must now demonstrate cooling in a form that can be photographed.

Compliance is optional. Non-compliance is also optional. Consequences are mandatory.

choices.label: COMPLY
choices.hint: -$200k now · standing +5 · rack failure rate x0.8 for 3d
choices.outcome: Photographs were taken of every fan. Reliability measurably improved from the attention.

choices.label: IGNORE
choices.outcome: The regulation continues to exist at you.

choices.label: PETITION FOR EXEMPTION
choices.outcome: A petition was filed. It will be heard when it has been read.

title: Annual Performance Review (Quarterly)
body:
Your facility will be reviewed against targets which are confidential, so as not to influence performance.

Please submit a self-assessment that is accurate, flattering and brief.

choices.label: SUBMIT A FLATTERING REPORT
choices.outcome: The Ministry loved it. The Ministry loves most things it did not write.

choices.label: SUBMIT AN HONEST REPORT
choices.outcome: The report was honest. A grant was issued to compensate for the shock.

choices.label: FILE IN TRIPLICATE
choices.outcome: Three self-assessments were filed, none matching. The average was commended.

title: Weather Advisory: Heatwave
body:
The Met Office advises that it will be hot, and has asked the sun to reconsider.

Cooling plants are reminded that ambient temperature is not a suggestion.

choices.label: RIDE IT OUT
choices.outcome: You did nothing. The weather continued doing something.

choices.label: HIRE EMERGENCY COOLING
choices.outcome: Rented chillers arrived on a truck marked 'FRAGILE (EMOTIONALLY)'.

choices.label: ISSUE A PUBLIC APPEAL
choices.hint: standing +2 · ambient +7°C for 1d · energy price x1.2 for 1d
choices.outcome: Citizens were asked to use less electricity. They used more, then felt better.

title: Weather Advisory: Cold Snap
body:
Temperatures are falling faster than your standing. Free cooling is available to any facility that can survive it.

Please note that condensation is a form of regret.

choices.label: ENJOY FREE COOLING
choices.hint: ambient -8°C for 1d · rack failure rate x1.3 for 1d
choices.outcome: Fans idled and the air was crisp. Condensation filed a quiet complaint.

choices.label: WINTERISE
choices.outcome: Gaskets, blankets and a sternly worded sign were installed.

choices.label: RUN SPACE HEATERS
choices.outcome: Heaters negated the cold snap at some expense to the cold snap.

title: Grid Notice: Scheduled Unscheduled Brownout
body:
The grid operator regrets to announce a brownout. The brownout regrets to announce you.

Imports will be reduced until the brownout has finished expressing itself.

choices.label: RIDE IT OUT
choices.outcome: You waited. The grid waited with you, but less.

choices.label: TOP UP THE GENSETS
choices.outcome: Fuel was bought. Gensets were thanked in writing.

choices.label: LODGE A FORMAL PROTEST
choices.hint: standing +2 · grid import x0.5 for 8h · -$10k now
choices.outcome: A protest was lodged. It lowered no one's voltage.

title: Grid Notice: Regional Blackout
body:
The regional grid has become a regional suggestion. Imports are suspended pending the return of electricity.

The Ministry recommends calm and, where applicable, batteries.

choices.label: ENDURE
choices.outcome: The lights went out and the Ministry sent a note saying so.

choices.label: BUY EMERGENCY POWER
choices.outcome: A truck of generators arrived. It was not the truck you ordered, but it worked.

choices.label: BLAME THE UTILITY
choices.outcome: The utility paid compensation to stop you describing it.

title: Basement Advisory: Moisture Has Opinions
body:
Groundwater has been observed on the lower levels, mostly in places it does not belong.

The Ministry classifies this as a leak, a flood or a reflection, depending on who is paying.

choices.label: PUMP IT OUT
choices.outcome: Pumps ran for hours. A few parts did not survive the experience.

choices.label: IGNORE
choices.outcome: The water noticed. Equipment noticed the water.

choices.label: FILE AN INSURANCE CLAIM
choices.outcome: The insurer paid and sent a note about the hydrological nature of claims.

title: Supply Notice: Component Shortage
body:
A shortage of spare components has been declared by the people who stock them.

Suppliers wish to remind customers that shortages are a natural phenomenon, like tides, and are billed accordingly.

choices.label: BUY ON THE SPOT MARKET
choices.outcome: Parts were bought at a price that was described as 'firm and slightly rude'.

choices.label: WAIT IT OUT
choices.outcome: Nothing was bought. The shelves looked emptier, but also cleaner.

choices.label: FILE A RATIONING ORDER
choices.hint: -$30k now · +4 spare parts · rack failure rate x1.2 for 12h
choices.outcome: Some parts were secured under a ration card that you are the only holder of.

title: Market Notice: Energy Price Spike
body:
Electricity prices are climbing for reasons the market describes as 'vibrant'.

Facilities may hedge, absorb, or take comfort in the fact that this was predicted by someone.

choices.label: HEDGE
choices.outcome: A hedge was purchased. It hedged.

choices.label: ABSORB THE COST
choices.outcome: You paid the price. The price was surprised.

choices.label: LOBBY THE REGULATOR
choices.hint: -$30k now · standing +2 · energy price x1.6 for 1d
choices.outcome: The regulator agreed to look into it, which is where it stayed.

title: Vendor Notice: GPU Batch 7B Recall
body:
A manufacturing defect was discovered in a batch of accelerators, shortly after it was discovered by customers.

Affected units will fail 'at an unspecified time of the vendor's choosing'.

choices.label: REPLACE PROACTIVELY
choices.outcome: Units were swapped in an orderly fashion. The vendor sent a gift basket of cables.

choices.label: MONITOR AND PRAY
choices.outcome: You watched the logs and hoped. One rack decided otherwise.

choices.label: DEMAND A REFUND
choices.outcome: The vendor refunded part of the cost and part of the dignity.

title: Firmware Advisory: Thermal Governor Errata
body:
A firmware update corrects an error in the thermal governor, introduced by the previous update correcting an error.

Installing the update is recommended. Not installing it is also recommended.

choices.label: INSTALL NOW
choices.hint: -$30k now · rack failure rate x0.85 for 3d
choices.outcome: The update installed after three reboots and one apology.

choices.label: SKIP IT
choices.outcome: The update was skipped. The bug was not.

choices.label: STAGE THE ROLLOUT
choices.hint: -$60k now · rack failure rate x0.95 for 3d · standing +1
choices.outcome: A careful rollout was run. It was careful, and long, and billed by the hour.

title: Security Alert: Message From An Unknown Benefactor
body:
A message arrived demanding payment in exchange for not having done something. It is unclear whether it has been done.

The Ministry will remain uninvolved and will assess the damage afterwards.

choices.label: PAY THE RANSOM
choices.outcome: The benefactor thanked you. You are on a list now.

choices.label: IGNORE IT
choices.outcome: Nothing happened, loudly. Two racks went offline for 'unrelated' reasons.

choices.label: HARDEN THE PERIMETER
choices.outcome: Passwords were rotated. Staff were rotated. The threat was rotated out.

title: Incident Report: Parts Have Left The Building
body:
A count of the depot shows that parts are no longer in it. They are presumed to be somewhere that is not here.

A report may be filed with the department that handles missing things, which is also missing.

choices.label: FILE A REPORT
choices.outcome: A report was filed. Two parts were returned in the report's honour.

choices.label: INSTALL NEW LOCKS
choices.outcome: New locks were fitted. The parts remain elsewhere, but the doors are proud.

choices.label: WRITE IT OFF
choices.outcome: Parts were written off. The auditor called it 'mature'.

title: Network Notice: Fibre Cut By Persons Unknown
body:
A digger has found your fibre. Your fibre was not looking for a digger.

The ISP regrets the inconvenience and the repair estimate, which will be revised upward by the time you have read this.

choices.label: PAY FOR PRIORITY REPAIR
choices.outcome: A crew arrived within hours and left a very small invoice and a very large one.

choices.label: WAIT FOR THE ISP
choices.outcome: Service resumed eventually. Clients found the wait memorable.

choices.label: REROUTE THROUGH A NEIGHBOUR
choices.hint: -$45k now · new contract payouts x0.95 for 1d · standing -1
choices.outcome: Traffic ran through a neighbour's line and was thanked, then charged.

title: Facilities Note: Rat Found In Cable Tray
body:
A rodent has been identified in a cable tray. The rodent has identified the cables.

The Ministry classifies the animal as 'a stakeholder'.

choices.label: SET HUMANE TRAPS
choices.outcome: The rat was relocated and has since written a short memoir.

choices.label: DO NOTHING
choices.outcome: The rat continued its work. A rack lost its signal and its composure.

choices.label: CALL THE EXTERMINATOR
choices.hint: -$60k now · standing -2 · rack failure rate x0.9 for 2d
choices.outcome: The exterminator was thorough, expensive and unnecessarily dramatic.

title: Staff Memo: Overtime, Defined
body:
Staff have noted that overtime is any time spent beyond the time the Ministry says exists.

A resolution is requested before the next shift is replaced by the previous one.

choices.label: PAY THE OVERTIME
choices.hint: -$90k now · +2 spare parts · rack failure rate x0.9 for 2d
choices.outcome: Staff were paid. They were so pleased they fixed two things.

choices.label: REFUSE
choices.hint: rack failure rate x1.25 for 2d · standing -2
choices.outcome: Staff worked to rule. The rule was surprisingly strict.

choices.label: OFFER TIME IN LIEU
choices.outcome: Staff received time in lieu, to be taken at a time that never arrives.

title: Client Request: Urgent, Please, By Yesterday
body:
A major client needs capacity urgently. They will pay for it, and they will remember how it went.

Their words were 'please', 'now' and 'surely'.

choices.label: ACCEPT THE RUSH
choices.hint: new contract payouts x1.4 for 1d · standing -2
choices.outcome: Rates were agreed at a premium. The rush promptly became a pace.

choices.label: POLITELY IGNORE
choices.outcome: You did not reply. The client replied to your not replying.

choices.label: NEGOTIATE
choices.hint: -$15k now · new contract payouts x1.2 for 36h
choices.outcome: A moderate premium was agreed after a moderate dispute.

title: Client Complaint: Concerning Concerns
body:
A client has written to raise concerns about concerns. They request a response, a response to the response, and a direct line to whoever is responsible.

That person has been identified. It is you.

choices.label: APOLOGISE
choices.outcome: A letter of apology was sent. It was apologetic in a way the client has since quoted.

choices.label: REBUT
choices.hint: standing -3 · new contract payouts x0.9 for 1d
choices.outcome: A rebuttal was sent. The client rebutted the rebuttal in a longer letter.

choices.label: OFFER A SERVICE CREDIT
choices.outcome: A credit was issued against future services that will be rendered.

title: Client Notice: Unexpected Gratitude
body:
A client was pleased. This has not happened before and the paperwork is therefore missing.

They propose a bonus, a testimonial, or a long lunch.

choices.label: ACCEPT THE BONUS
choices.outcome: The bonus arrived. It had a note attached that said 'don't make it weird'.

choices.label: ACCEPT THE TESTIMONIAL
choices.outcome: A glowing review was published. It was glowing at an angle.

choices.label: ATTEND THE LONG LUNCH
choices.hint: new contract payouts x1.25 for 2d · -$20k now
choices.outcome: The lunch lasted until the following quarter. Contracts improved.

title: Client Notice: A Rival Has Made An Offer
body:
A rival facility has approached one of your clients with prices that cannot be real and terms that cannot be read.

Your client is mentioning this to you to be helpful.

choices.label: MATCH THE OFFER
choices.hint: new contract payouts x0.85 for 3d · standing +2
choices.outcome: Prices were matched. The margin was matched too, somewhere below zero.

choices.label: HOLD YOUR PRICES
choices.outcome: You held your prices. The client held its breath, then its contract.

choices.label: SEND A GIFT BASKET
choices.hint: -$60k now · standing +1 · new contract payouts x1.1 for 1d
choices.outcome: A gift basket was sent. It was a very good basket.
